1. WHAT FRACTION RESOLVES, AND THE UNMATCHED KINDS -- IS REC (a) SUFFICIENT, OR DOES THE PRODUCER NEED RE-KEYING. REC (a) as literally named in the task order (join through dim_identity_crosswalk) resolves 0 of 22,646 live 49financial ownership-map account slots (0 percent; 0 of 43 for abby_horton), measured live this run against gold/advi/dimensions/dim_identity_crosswalk/date=2026-09-16/data.parquet (infra/aws/lambda/investor-reporting/_ids/data/custodian_key_seam.json's own _rec_a_as_named_measured field @16afdf4881) -- NOT SUFFICIENT, unambiguously. This cell substituted the SAME face's own alternative ('or through the projection's existing read path'): blackdiamond/49f/silver/dim_account_xref, already read by data/assets/scripts/gold/investor_reporting/directory_runner.py:326-332 @de4e176cc3 on the host session (no new grant). That bridge resolves 17,895 of 22,646 (79.0 percent; 21 of 43 for abby_horton, 48.8 percent) -- the ONE unmatched kind this cell's own projection can name is UNRESOLVED-BY-SEAM (4,751 of 22,646 slots), returned raw rather than minted (infra/aws/lambda/investor-reporting/_ids/ids.py's projection_with_seam @16afdf4881). Whether 79 percent is durable or whether the ownership-map PRODUCER needs re-keying (alternative b) turns on ONE fact this cell did not chase because it is out of bound (no ownership-map write): data/assets/scripts/gold/runners_49f/d08_firm_ownership_map.py's own docstring (lines 13-19 @<the commit at this cell's cut>) DECLARES the served artifact rides 'the BLACK DIAMOND z-id grammar' as an INTENTIONAL, temporary divergence pending a future cutover to 'the canonical spine' the emitter's code already computes internally (the SAME Schwab zfill-10 spine the directory mints from) -- meaning the PRODUCER ALREADY HAS THE CORRECT DATA IN HAND and is choosing, by a shape-freezing convention, to serve the old grammar. If that cutover is executed, resolution goes to (up to) 100 percent with NO seam needed at all; until it is, dim_account_xref's OWN documented status ('best effort, never load-bearing for identity', data/assets/scripts/gold/investor_reporting/directory_runner.py's own comment @de4e176cc3) caps this cell's bridge below 100 percent for accounts the reconciliation table itself never covered. Alternative (b) -- re-keying the producer -- is therefore not merely sufficient but likely the CORRECT, DURABLE answer, because it is a cutover the producer already declares as its own destination.

2. INFLECTION AND COTTONWOOD -- MEASURED, NO FIX. Both firms' live ownership maps are EMPTY at this cell's cut: cottonwood's platinum/cottonwood/ownership_map.json object EXISTS with 0 advisors (0 of 0, VACUOUS); inflection's platinum/inflection/ownership_map.json object DOES NOT EXIST at all (loaders.load_ownership's own rule treats an absent map as {schema_version:1, advisors:{}}, infra/aws/lambda/investor-reporting/_authz/loaders.py:93-116 @47f21dab95 -- unedited by this order). This is a live, standing gap this order's own measurement surfaces and does not close.

3. IS FWD-1/2/5's SERVED PATH REACHABLE FOR A REAL ADVISOR, OR ONLY THE PROJECTED SUBSET. NEITHER, as measured: abby_horton -- the SAME real advisor IB-rte-1 chose specifically because she is the only 49financial advisor with a live TERMINATED account (FWD-1's own capability gap) -- still reads code=UNPROJECTED_GRANT end to end (battery_ib_rte_6.py arm_d_live_route, this run, against the deployed, verified bytes). The REFUSAL MECHANISM itself (FirmBinding, guard(), the six-guard covers(), and now id_projection) is proven sound end to end by this cell's own arms and by IB-rt-2/IB-rtb-1's prior fixture-grounded batteries; what remains unreachable is the SERVED branch specifically, for the SAME reason row IRPT_BCKEND-W1-S22 first found it unreachable -- a gap in the DATA, not in the CODE this order was scoped to fix.
